name: tmt-fueling
description: PWA for recording fueling transactions and pushing TMT Fleet Maintenance fuel tickets via MCP

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c amber,cyan "npm run dev -w @tmt-fueling/api" "npm run dev -w @tmt-fueling/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tmt-fueling/tmt-client && npm run build -w @tmt-fueling/api && npm run build -w @tmt-fueling/web && npm run build -w @tmt-fueling/tmt-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tmt-fueling/tmt-client && npm run typecheck -w @tmt-fueling/api && npm run typecheck -w @tmt-fueling/web && npm run typecheck -w @tmt-fueling/tmt-mcp
